# Local third-party vendors (no CDN)

| File | Use |
|------|-----|
| xlsx.full.min.js | Excel parse |
| exceljs.min.js | Excel export with images |
| html5-qrcode.min.js | Camera scan |
| iconify-icon.min.js | Icons |
| icons-ant-design.json | Offline icons |
| iconify-offline.js | Load local icons |
| qrcode-generator.min.js | QR core |
| qrcode-adapter.js | QRCode.toCanvas |

Large binaries may be gitignored; download and place here for offline runs.
